messages:
Carmen Lee: quick proposal  pilot an automated 'deprioritize stale contacts' playbook to reduce noisy owner nudges. when contact_last_seen > 90d AND last_activity_score < 2 -> set crm.deprioritized=true and hold routing for 14d. low-risk 1% canary.

Noah Brooks: good idea. key asks: feature flag, explicit owner opt-out, audit log in CRM, and a manual reclaim flow so owners can re-enable.

Tara Iyer: agree. define stale: last_seen_ts older than 90d OR contact_has_no_phone OR role == null. hold window 14d then re-evaluate via scoring.

Carmen Lee: sample event payload: `{"account_id":"acct_777","contact_id":"ct_555","owner_id":"u_noah","last_seen_ts":"2024-05-01T12:00:00Z","activity_score":1,"event_id":"evt-1789-1"}`. use event_id for idempotency.

DevEx: draft playbook (staging) below. keeping it minimal so we can add an owner override and audit notes: 
```yaml
id: deprioritize-stale-contacts-v1
trigger:
  type: event
  event_name: contact.lifecycle_check
sample_rate: 0.01  # 1% canary
conditions:
  - last_seen_days > 90
  - activity_score < 2
actions:
  - set_crm_field:
      field: deprioritized
      value: true
  - set_crm_field:
      field: deprio_hold_until
      value: "{{now + 14d}}"
  - append_crm_audit_note:
      note: "auto-deprioritized by playbook (deprioritize-stale-contacts-v1). event_id={{event_id}}"
  - route_to_owner_for_visibility:
      owner_field: owner_id
      only_if: owner_opt_in=true  # default false for pilot
meta:
  feature_flag: deprio_stale_contacts_v1
  dedupe_key: event_id
```

Noah Brooks: please make owner_opt_in default false; we only surface to owners if they explicitly opt-in. add a per-owner backlog cap and an alert if more than 10 deprioritizations in 1h for a single owner.

Tara Iyer: telemetry rules: tag with `deprio_stale_contacts_v1` and emit metrics: `deprio.count`, `deprio.reclaimed`, `deprio.owner_alert`. acceptance: reclaim rate <5% in 14d, owner surprise alerts <2 per week.

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: draft created in staging (deprioritize-stale-contacts-v1).

Ops Bot: ops notes: implement idempotency on event_id, store audit note with user who triggered manual reclaim, and provide a one-click undo in CRM UI. adding a small backoff queue so mass-deprio events don't flood the CRM write pipeline.

Carmen Lee: rollout plan: 1) stage test with sample events -> 2) feature-flagged 1% canary in prod (owner_opt_in=false) -> 3) monitor metrics and owner feedback for 7 days -> 4) expand to 5% and enable owner visibility for opted-in owners.

Noah Brooks: i'll prepare the CS ops runbook with steps to revert (feature-flag off, clear deprio flags via backfill job) and include SLA alarms for `deprio.count` spikes.

Tara Iyer: adding analytics dashboard slice to show deprio by industry, ARR bucket, and owner. will surface reclaim reasons so we can tune heuristics.

Carmen Lee: quick QA checklist: replay 500 synthetic stale events, verify dedupe prevents duplicates, confirm audit notes present, simulate owner reclaim flow and ensure `deprio.reclaimed` metric emits.

DevEx: sharing staging curl for replay tests: `curl -X POST https://staging-events.internal/contact.lifecycle_check -d @stale_sample.json`. sample.json includes unique event_id.

Playbook Bot: scheduled staging deploy window tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Carmen Lee: thanks all. short thread but should cut down noisy nudges and improve owner signal. sync in #cs-ops 09:30 PT to sign off.
